glosses: plaza (a public square or open area in front of a building or a place)

examples.en: There were many children in the square.

examples.text: Tenham cuidado ao atravessar a praça.
examples.en: Be careful when crossing the square.

examples.text: A praça está cheia de bicicletas.
examples.en: The square is full of bicycles.

examples.text: Eu fui para a praça domingo passado.
examples.en: I went to the park last Sunday.
